During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''human''' worked as a security guard at [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. Around [[9 ABY]], they were with the [[Unidentified Lanupa hotelier|hotel director]] when she welcomed [[Jod Na Nawood]] and a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[youngling]]s who were posing as "Wise Elders" from the [[Bratric system]]. Later during the groups visit they were captured by a [[Silvo's pirates|group]] of [[priate]]s in the tunnels under the spa. 

==Biography==
They were a [[human]] security guard for the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]].<ref name="SC 105" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> he<ref name="SC 105 AD" /> watched the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'' touch down on at the spa. Later that [[Standard day|day]] they were part of a group of guards searching the tunnels under the spa for the ''Onyx Cinder'' crew. They were taken prisoner by a [[Silvo's pirates|group]] of [[pirate]]s after the [[First Mate]] [[Gunter]] shot another [[Unidentified Lanupa security grunt|security guard]] causing them to fall into a spike trap.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Personality and traits==
They were a human with short [[Color|black]] [[hair]], a short black beard, brown [[eye]]s and dark skin.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Equipment==
While working at the spa, they wore a [[Color|green]] [[Clothing|uniform]] with a white [[helmet]], white [[belt]] and white [[glove]]s.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Behind the scenes==
The veteran appeared in ''[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode that premiered on [[December 25]], [[2024]] and was portrayed by [[Dwayne Colbert ]].<ref name="SC 105" />
